svg.title: Reproduce the supported M3.1 gates
svg.desc: Linux build prerequisites and authorized SSH access to exact Hive/DeTTa sources are documented in the runbook; public HTTPS retrieves the pinned Reachability/PLN sources. New native objects, Python/Janus venv and DeTTa Cargo target are built in a fresh directory. Download caches may be warm. build_m3.py preserves the M2 build recipe and adds the explicit deduction profile. verify_m3_1.py runs the complete M1–M3 verifier plus closure fixtures, real-provider methods, direct process kills and native Hive closure. The final record was executed from clean detached /tmp/fusion-m31-final-corrected. Use --output with a fresh evidence directory to avoid confusing prior runs. Fresh new-profile journals are required. Do not publish broad local environment files. Deck generation is a separate documentation operation and does not rerun these gates.
svg.text: Use the tested revision or a reviewed descendant, with source access and a fresh destination.
VERIFY M1–M3 REGRESSION + CLOSURE + REAL PROVIDERS + NATIVE HIVE
Read: manifest.json → final/verification.json → suite logs → source-audit.json
Source access, fixture tests, native execution and archived evidence are separate reproducibility requirements.
OMEGA × ASI / THROUGH M3.1 / runbook.md · build_m3.py · verify_m3_1.py
